findings: The retained candidate does not add a large run or main stack frame: run, main, current_executable_identity, and print_usage have identical symbol sizes and relevant frame setup before and after.
The changed MCE start function has 965 more text bytes and a 144-byte larger frame. This is materially smaller than the approximately 8 MiB process high-water shift and does not establish causation.

The executable R-E LOAD segment grows by 9,584 bytes and all LOAD p_align values are 0x1000. The observed THP mode is madvise. Static ELF data therefore does not demonstrate an executable large-folio or huge-page residency effect; live smaps is required.

The benchmark process RSS field is a post-operation process-lifetime VmHWM, and GNU time %M is also a command high-water value. Both include setup that precedes process_before; operation allocation metrics have a narrower begin/finish interval.
The 0888 monitor snapshots status and smaps from the executable child while it is live. They are non-atomic samples and sampled maxima must remain separate from GNU time peaks.
limits: This audit does not run a workload, build a binary, or claim a latency result.
ELF section and prolog differences alone cannot distinguish file-backed executable residency from anonymous setup allocations.
The retained binaries are compared by static layout; a clean rebuild need not be byte-identical without the retained files.
